name: Skarbrand
canonNotes: The Exiled One, a Bloodthirster who once struck at Khorne himself and was cast out; now pure, endless rage.
Leaves only slaughter wherever he goes.
voiceNotes: Almost wordless fury; short roars of blood and hate.
Has no interest in talk; everything is a fight.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
